avis.texte: I was paying much more for a very similar product. When I switched to Clarins Exfoliating Cleanser, it worked a lot better on my skin. Thank you Clarins!

I use this one after I remove my makeup, and only once or twice a week. I love how it feels on my skin, and my skin always looks alive and radiant after. I will continue to use this product as I do; it is a great way to make sure you get a deep clean without irritating your skin.
The only cleanser I trust! Removes makeup effortlessly and skin feels refreshed afterwards!
Feels so clean. I love the smell and washing my face with it.
I love this gentle exfoliator! It removed makeup and skin oils without stripping my skin. It has helped so much with my acne and texture in skin!

avis.titre: Long-time user - What about a "value size?"
avis.texte: I have used the exfoliating cleanser for many years as part of my skincare regimen. My skin has changed with age, and I now need to intersperse it with other products that provide stronger exfoliation to manage hyperkeratosis. My husband and young-adult sons use it on a daily basis: It's convenient for them to gently cleanse and exfoliate in the shower, and they like the scent. I find that the "new" cap is harder to open (with my moderate hand arthritis) but so far, it's manageable. I took off one star for this, for the smaller size of the tube, and because of the price. My guys go through a tube rather quickly. Clarins should consider providing a "value size" of this to reduce environmental waste.
I've been using the Exfoliating Cleanser for over 3 months and my esthetician says she has really seen a dramatic change on my skin.

I have used this product for many years but recently they changed the formula. I always used this in the shower and it left a great clean but not dry feel afterwards. the new version is really not the same, I dont like it at all! It is thinner so now gets in my eyes easily and my skin feels very dry after using it. I still have 1 tube of the old version, but dont know what I will do after I finish it... bring back the old version Clarins!

I've been using the Clarins One-Step Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser for about 8 years, and it's still one of my favorite skincare products. I use it twice a week, and it always leaves my skin feeling incredibly clean, fresh, and smooth. It does a great job of removing all the dirt, oil, and buildup from everyday life without making my skin feel stripped or dry. I have visible pores, and this cleanser really helps keep them feeling clean and unclogged. After each use, my skin looks brighter and feels refreshed. It's gentle enough to use regularly while still providing an effective exfoliation. After all these years, it's a product I continue to repurchase and highly recommend.
This face scrub is ideal to use in the shower when the skin is moisturized and steamed. Two times a week is enough.

I just started to get into Clarins, and I love this cleanser! I'm almost in my 40s with dry skin, and this cleanser is very gentle. The beads are soft for a light exfoliation but the cleanser took off ALL my makeup after softly rubbing it around my face for a minute. I will definitely be repurchasing! Xo

avis.titre: Gentle and kind to my skin
avis.texte: I have been looking for a good exfoliating cleanser for my dry, sensitive skin. This is perfect!
Love the way it leave my skin been using products for a while
This is the best exfoliating cleanser. It's so creamy going on and leaves my face smooth and hydrated.

I have been using this exfoliating cleanser as part of my skin routine for years. I absolutely love it! I choose to use this 3 days a week, opposite the gentle cream cleanser. I tend to have very sensitive and dry skin - this cleanser is very gentle and feels like what the estheticians use at the spa! Plus the smell is divine. It is an absolutely must have for me!
This exfoliating cleanser is gentle & not over drying. I use it everyday & Love it, makes my skin feel & look clean & refreshed. You only need a small amount, it will become foamy with a little water
Great exfoliating product . Love the clean feel after exfoliating and softness .

I've been using this cleanser for the last 4 months. I love it! It's gentle but effective. The micro beads give me a little facial every time I use it. You only need a little so this lasts quite awhile. My face feels refreshed and bright after use.
This cleanser it great! I use it every night to get a deep clean on my face. It only takes a little amount of product to get a good clean. Have never had a reaction to it and the scent is soft.
I absolutely love this and it smells good too. I'm glad I purchased this and will buy again
I love the way it cleans my face. I have only been using your products for 2months.
Nothing makes my face cleaner and smoother. Very gentle but effective. Absolutely love. 10 out of 10!
I bought this every month. I used 3 times a week .Also my daughter and son..

avis.titre: Three Issues Solved in One Product!
avis.texte: This is an excellent product! I use it 3X/week when I shower. It cleanses, exfoliates, and cleans pores, leaving my skin brighter and more youthful.

avis.titre: Smooth and clean without the dry
avis.texte: This is my favorite gentle exfoliator of all time. It smells so fresh and leaves my skin smooth without feeling dry.
I love it. I use it everyday and it's gentle on my skin. I would recommend it.
Love this multi-use cleanser that gently exfoliates to slough off the dead skin cells for better product penetration.

Great gentle exfoliating cleanser—it leaves my skin feeling very clean and noticeably brighter. I use it at night to remove all my makeup. I still prefer the previous version, but this one definitely doesn't disappoint.

I use this exfoliating cleanser once a week, it is very gentle. I don't feel like it makes me break out, stripping my skin or it is oily. I have dry skin and my skin has looked much better with using Clarins products.
I use it on my lips and nose. Gentle, but clears any blackheads and gently exfoliates the lips. Once a day. A pea size drop is all you need. It smells so great.
Gentle exfoliator; it does not feel harsh. I use it every night
Tried this for the first time. The reviews are on point. It left my skin feeling great and it smells beautifully.
I like this cleanser a lot. Mild scrubbers are gentle enough fur daily use.

I've been using Clarin for more than 30 years . I love the one step cleanser.

Just wish the scrub grains were finer in texture with a revisit to its structure. They could be less harsh in feel and more effective at the same time with the amazing lather this product already produces.
It cleans effectively while being very gentle on the skin, making it perfect for everyday use without causing irritation.
I've been using this product for many years. It removes makeup and cleans pores really well leaving my face moisturized and squeaky clean. Highly recommended!
Really, really love it. Classic Clarins product - gentle, effective. Pure class. Puts modern harsh stripping products to shame.
Great cleanser. Leaves the skin really smooth and soft afterwards.

This is a great face wash. It is gentle enough to use daily and leaves your face feeling refreshed and clean. It does not dry your face dry. It also lasts a long time too, because it just takes a tiny bit each wash. The smaller size is perfect for travel.
Leaves skin feeling so clean but not dry. Smells great! Did not know I could like a face wash so much!
This texture is one of the best textures that I've ever felt in a cream! The consistency is great and it also foams as well! It is super clean and I'm in all of its cleanliness.
My skin has never felt so good! My skin is clear of blemishes and soft as it used to be when I was younger.

avis.titre: Superb Product ... both exfoliating and hydrating

I use this, then apply double serum and the Cryo Mask, and that combination is a great, in home facial. This is a tried and true product (that I use 3 times a week, previously daily, but in menopause, I am a bit gentler on daily exfoliant.
So happy with my gentle exfoliating cleanser! It's mild but leaves my skin feeling smooth and soft!

I've been using Clarins cleansers for over 8 years, and I truly preferred the original formulas. Since the reformulation, most of the cleansers have caused irritation on my skin, which has been very disappointing. This is currently the only cleanser from Clarins that does not irritate my skin. It feels gentle and works well for me, so I appreciate that. However, I still miss the old formula, it was more comfortable and suited my skin better. I hope Clarins considers bringing back the original versions in the future.
I have been using this for years, it's one of my favorite cleansers. It's great for everyday to help keep my face clear and smooth.

avis.titre: I will continue to buy it!

My skin has been loving this brand! Worth the price completely!

The very best. I use morning and night! Makes me feel clean and awake!
Love this cleanser. Not rough or grainy like other exfoliates. Clean fresh scent. Makes my face feel clean and fresh!

Have been using this gentle exfoliating cleanser for several years. My face is smoother and I think it's helping prevent wrinkles. Just for reference I'm 65.
Love it. It's gentle on my face yet effective. Does the job well.
I use this product everyday. I like the way my skin feels so clean and fresh.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again

this product felt very nice on my sensitive skin. It was gentle yet exfoliating made my skin feel very clean after and it wasn't over drying I didn't leave any weird greasy feeling on my skin and it was easy to rinse off.
